newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein unchanged in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein unchanged in dull trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were unchanged in dull late trading on Thursday amid tight supply and with most players yet to resume trading after the Eid al-Fitr and Lunar New Year celebrations, traders said.

They said olein was unchanged at 1,450-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, up from 1,450 rupiah/kg at the close on Wednesday. They said crude palm oil was still quoted at 1,270 rupiah/kg, unchanged since early February.
"The market is quiet and ignores rises in Malaysia because many players are still on holiday. We expect the market to return to normal next Monday," said one trader.
